_reader_contract: Data rows are found by the HEADER, never by a fixed row number: the header row is the one whose column A reads "Publish as"; metadata rows below it begin with the arrow marker; data starts at the first row after the last marker row.
As of 2026-09-30 there are three metadata rows - MARKET VISITED, DATE COLLECTED and COLLECTED BY - so data begins at row 6. That number is documentation, not a constant.
Columns B, C and D are now filled on every data row. No row depends on the one above it, so the sheet survives a sort.
_rules: A tracker key is (Product, Variety) within one sheet. Several keys may map to one commodity.
PENDING means the importer MUST refuse the row. It is not a default and not a guess (P0.2).
confidence "check" means the match needs a human decision before import.

primary_units._status: APPROVED in bulk 2026-09-30. Earliest-row tie-break confirmed by the owner.
primary_units._rule: (1) If the commodity already has a published series, its unit is primary. (2) Otherwise the unit of a price already in the tracker for that commodity and tier - earliest week column; if two different units are priced in the same column the pair is flagged. (3) Otherwise the first portion listed for that tier. A portion whose unit is still PENDING cannot be primary and is skipped; if every portion for that tier is held, the pair is unresolved and the importer refuses it.
